requires.reason: builds the determinism lint for the host

structural: -nostdlib removes every C library symbol, so a clock, socket, thread or random source cannot be linked at all
-ffreestanding removes the hosted environment assumptions the standard library depends on
the SDK exposes no allocator; every buffer is caller-owned, so a program carries no ambient authority
WebAssembly linear memory is zero-initialised, so even an unwritten read is deterministic
